race.title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Beginners Chase
race.verdict: DOCTOR STEINBERG looked a top-class prospect when demolishing 7 rivals in a Grade 1 novice hurdle last season and, though things did not go to plan afterwards, is likely to prove hard to beat now switched to fences. The highly promising Court Compliance is feared most, while Fort Dino is also respected after an encouraging chase debut. DOCTOR STEINBERG (IRE) COURT COMPLIANCE (IRE) FORT DINO (FR)
race.bettingForecast: Doctor Steinberg (8/11), Fort Dino (6/1), Stede Bonnet (13/2), Court Compliance (8/1), Franciscan Rock (10/1), Fire Coral (12/1), Walks In June (14/1), Farnahoe Rebel (50/1)
